name: Gearbox
text:
Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It sharpens faces and fine details better than RealVisXL’s realism boost, which blurs faces under heavy upscaling—critical for EXCAVA’s output quality. The trade-off is slightly slower upscaling speed, but the face fidelity gain outweighs the speed loss. Run a blind A/B test on 100 faces to confirm the clarity lift before full rollout.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler risks inconsistent results across varied lighting—faces may sharpen in one shot but distort in another. Test it on 100 faces under three lighting conditions; if clarity scores drop by >10% in any condition, default to SD3.5 Medium + RealVisXL LoRA for stable gains.
